handback.t:
Status: DONE for fix round 2. I made one new commit, ad9505456 "fix(console): /ruflo verbs win over page names" (unpushed).
- **Fix:** `commands.ts` now exports `VERBS`, which lists every case of `parseRuflo`'s switch. The multi-word page-name match runs only when the first word is not a verb. So `/ruflo swarm topology` delegates to `ruflo-swarm` with 'topology' and `/ruflo agent timeline` drills into the agent 'timeline', both as on base. `learning lab` opens neural and `claims board` opens claims.
- **Menu prompt:** the 'swarm topology' alias stays in `RETIRED_NAMES`. The menu prompt has no verbs, so nothing collides there.
- **Tests:** new `tests/commands-verbs.spec.ts` has four tests.
  - The four parses above.
  - `VERBS` equals the switch cases, read from the source so it cannot drift.
  - Every verb-first line of the /ruflo help never parses as a page open. It skips lines whose verb is open, agent, swarm, events or timeline, so those are not covered.
  - The case-insensitive `Claims Board` parse.
- **RED/GREEN:** I did not run the new spec against the pre-fix code. The RED was the reviewer's reproduced behaviour (`swarm topology` opening the swarm page) plus the missing `VERBS` export. After the change the spec passes.
- **Specs:** `commands-verbs`, `group-scheme`, `key-labels`, `nav*`, `help-docs`, commands/bindings and `menu-*` all pass (9 files, 99 tests).
- **Not run:** `tests/palette.test.ts` cannot load here (`claude-code/testing` is missing, same as before). Its `swarm topology` case goes through the verb branch, which is unchanged.
- **Validator:** `claude plugin validate plugins/ruflo-console` ended with "Validation passed".
- **Report:** the "Fix round 2" section is appended to `C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\task-B5-report.md`.
